query: Across all six composers, how many composers feature the singer Haricharan on their soundtracks?
ref_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT composer) FROM (SELECT s1.title AS song, s2.name AS singer, substr(s1.date,1,4) AS year, 'arr' AS composer FROM songs s1 JOIN singers s2 ON s1.song_id=s2.song_id UNION ALL SELECT s1.song AS song, s2.singer AS singer, substr(s1.release_date,1,4) AS year, 'ila' AS composer FROM songs_ila s1 JOIN singers_ila s2 ON s1.song_id=s2.song_id UNION ALL SELECT s1.song AS song, s2.singer AS singer, substr(s1.release_date,1,4) AS year, 'pri' AS composer FROM songs_pri s1 JOIN singers_pri s2 ON s1.song_id=s2.song_id UNION ALL SELECT s1.song AS song, s2.singer AS singer, substr(s1.release_date,1,4) AS year, 'sel' AS composer FROM songs_sel s1 JOIN singers_sel s2 ON s1.song_id=s2.song_id UNION ALL SELECT s1.song AS song, s2.singer AS singer, substr(s1.release_date,1,4) AS year, 'sus' AS composer FROM songs_sus s1 JOIN singers_sus s2 ON s1.song_id=s2.song_id UNION ALL SELECT s1.song AS song, s2.singer AS singer, substr(s1.release_date,1,4) AS year, 'vsh' AS composer FROM songs_vsh s1 JOIN singers_vsh s2 ON s1.song_id=s2.song_id) u WHERE singer LIKE '%Haricharan%'

query: Across all six composers, how many composers feature the singer Shreya Ghoshal on their soundtracks?

query: How many music composers did the singer Mohit Chauhan sing for?
ref_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT composer) FROM (SELECT s1.title AS song, s2.name AS singer, substr(s1.date,1,4) AS year, 'arr' AS composer FROM songs s1 JOIN singers s2 ON s1.song_id=s2.song_id UNION ALL SELECT s1.song AS song, s2.singer AS singer, substr(s1.release_date,1,4) AS year, 'ila' AS composer FROM songs_ila s1 JOIN singers_ila s2 ON s1.song_id=s2.song_id UNION ALL SELECT s1.song AS song, s2.singer AS singer, substr(s1.release_date,1,4) AS year, 'pri' AS composer FROM songs_pri s1 JOIN singers_pri s2 ON s1.song_id=s2.song_id UNION ALL SELECT s1.song AS song, s2.singer AS singer, substr(s1.release_date,1,4) AS year, 'sel' AS composer FROM songs_sel s1 JOIN singers_sel s2 ON s1.song_id=s2.song_id UNION ALL SELECT s1.song AS song, s2.singer AS singer, substr(s1.release_date,1,4) AS year, 'sus' AS composer FROM songs_sus s1 JOIN singers_sus s2 ON s1.song_id=s2.song_id UNION ALL SELECT s1.song AS song, s2.singer AS singer, substr(s1.release_date,1,4) AS year, 'vsh' AS composer FROM songs_vsh s1 JOIN singers_vsh s2 ON s1.song_id=s2.song_id) u WHERE singer LIKE '%Mohit Chauhan%'
